framework.name: King V Report (draft, April 2025)

framework.description: Draft successor to King IV: a plain-language rewrite with consolidated principles, a two-year cooling-off for former executives claiming independence, a nine-year tenure rule for independence, Risk and Social & Ethics Committees each requiring at least one independent non-executive director, and a substantially expanded technology chapter covering AI governance.
